# journals.niepublish.com

> > A multidisciplinary open-access academic journal portal publishing peer-reviewed research across education, sustainability, business, technology, and regional development.

Nature and Information Engineering Publishing operates a collection of specialized peer-reviewed journals covering diverse fields from eco-tourism and sustainable development to emerging markets and educational technology. The platform serves as a scholarly collaboration hub for researchers across Asia and globally.

## Key Topics

- open-access journals
- peer-reviewed research
- academic publishing
- sustainable development
- educational technology
- emerging markets
- cross-cultural studies
- environmental ethics
- Southeast Asia
- journal submissions
- multidisciplinary research
- scholarly collaboration
- human resources management
- regional innovation
- language services

## Core Journals

- [Eco-Tourism and Sustainable Development](https://journals.niepublish.com/etsd): Peer-reviewed open-access journal on eco-tourism and sustainable development (ISSN 3083-970X)
- [Cross-Cultural Education Studies](https://journals.niepublish.com/cces): Academic journal on cross-cultural education, comparative studies, and globalization
- [Innovations in Pedagogy and Technology](https://journals.niepublish.com/ipt): Open-access journal on educational technology and teaching methodology (ISSN 3093-7175)
- [Journal of Emerging Markets and Management](https://journals.niepublish.com/jemm): Peer-reviewed open-access journal on emerging markets and business management
- [Journal of Language Service Studies](https://journals.niepublish.com/jlss): Academic journal on language services, translation, and interpreting (ISSN 3093-7841)
- [Contemporary Visual Culture and Art](https://journals.niepublish.com/cvca): Open-access peer-reviewed journal on contemporary visual culture and artistic analysis
- [Human Resource Strategy and Practice](https://journals.niepublish.com/hrsp): Academic journal on HR management strategy, employee engagement, and organizational practice
- [Environmental Ethics & Law](https://journals.niepublish.com/eel): Academic journal on environmental ethics, law, climate change, and ecosystem conservation

## Specialized Research Journals

- [Journal of Perception and Control](https://journals.niepublish.com/jpc): Open-access quarterly journal on robotics, computer vision, and automation (ISSN 3093-8031)
- [Southeast Asia Development Research](https://journals.niepublish.com/sadr): Academic journal on Southeast Asian development, foreign investment, and industrial growth
- [Standards-related Regional Innovation and International Cooperation](https://journals.niepublish.com/sriic): Journal on regional innovation systems and global standardization frameworks
